title: Sample Size & Research Methodology
tagline: G*Power calculations, sampling designs, instrument validity, and ethical research.
outcomes: Differentiate quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods research paradigms.
Calculate required sample sizes using Cochran's formula with finite population correction.
Execute a priori statistical power analyses in G*Power for t-tests, ANOVA, and regression models.
Design valid survey questionnaires, pilot test items, and establish ethical research protocols.

modules.description: Align epistemological paradigms with research questions and variable measurement scales.

lessons.title: Scales of Measurement: Nominal, Ordinal, Interval, Ratio

modules.title: Module 2: Sampling Techniques & Cochran's Formula
modules.description: Probability vs non-probability sampling, and statistical sample size calculations.

lessons.title: Calculating Sample Size for Unknown Populations

modules.title: Module 3: G*Power & Statistical Power Analysis
modules.description: Compute statistical power, alpha, effect size, and required sample sizes across test families.

lessons.title: A Priori Power Analysis for t-tests, ANOVA, and Regression
